gloss: one of them; some one; any one

definitions.gloss: one of them; some one (of several); any one (of several)
definitions.explanation: An indefinite pronoun referring to an unspecified item from a group of three or more things.

examples.japanese: どれか⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧どれか⟦お{気|き}に{入|い}り→お気に入り：10297_okiniiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there one among these that you like?

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧のうちどれか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}め→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧⟦{一長一短|いっちょういったん}→一長一短：04774_icchouittan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have to decide on one of the three proposals, but each has its pros and cons.

notes:
Formed from ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ (which one) + ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (indefinite marker). Used when selecting from three or more items. For choosing between two items, ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧ is used instead. The ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ particle converts the interrogative ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ into an indefinite pronoun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どれか⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one of them
- どれか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on one of them
- どれか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose one of them
- 〜のうちどれか: one of ~

RELATED INDEFINITE PRONOUNS:
- ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧: somewhere
- だれか: someone
- なにか: something
- ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧: one of two; either one
- いつか: sometime
